authentic.en: The manuscript contains authentic field notes recorded during the original expedition.
authentic.zh: 该手稿包含最初远征期间记录的原始田野笔记。

authentic.en: Researchers questioned whether the letters were authentic or later fabrications.
authentic.zh: 研究者质疑这些信件究竟是原件还是后来伪造的赝品。

authentic.en: The museum acquired an authentic example of the regional folk tradition.
authentic.zh: 博物馆购得了一件该地区民间传统的真品。

autonomous.en: The region obtained autonomous status and began drafting its own regulations.
autonomous.zh: 该地区取得自治地位后开始起草自己的规章。

autonomous.en: Robots must remain autonomous while operating in unstructured outdoor environments.
autonomous.zh: 机器人在非结构化的户外环境中运行时必须保持自主运作。

autonomous.en: Faculty members strongly resisted the introduction of autonomous managerial control over research.
autonomous.zh: 教职人员强烈反对把自主的经营控制引入学术研究。

beneficial.en: Moderate exercise proved beneficial for patients recovering from cardiac surgery.
beneficial.zh: 适度运动被证明有益于心脏手术后的康复患者。

beneficial.en: Subsidies for public transport remain beneficial to urban air quality.
beneficial.zh: 公共交通补贴对改善城市空气质量仍然有益。

beneficial.en: The authors argue that shared infrastructure would be beneficial for both sectors.
beneficial.zh: 作者认为共享基础设施对两个部门都会有益。

categorical.en: The proposed coding scheme produces categorical variables that simplify subsequent statistical analysis.
categorical.zh: 所提出的编码方案生成分类变量，从而简化了随后的统计分析。

categorical.en: His categorical rejection of quantitative evidence drew criticism from reviewers.
categorical.zh: 他对定量证据一概排斥的做法受到评审者批评。

categorical.en: The framework replaces loose groupings with clearly defined categorical distinctions.
categorical.zh: 该框架以明确划分的类别取代了宽泛的分组。

characteristic.en: Characteristic features of the language include a rare aspirated consonant.
characteristic.zh: 这种语言的典型特征包括一个罕见的送气辅音。

characteristic.en: The mineral displays the characteristic crystalline structure of its chemical group.
characteristic.zh: 该矿物呈现出其所属化学族的特有晶体结构。

characteristic.en: Such delays are characteristic of archival research conducted under restricted access.
characteristic.zh: 这类延误是限制查阅条件下开展档案研究的典型特征。

collective.en: The collective effort of the research team shortened the experimental timeline considerably.
collective.zh: 研究团队的集体努力大幅缩短了实验周期。

collective.en: Collective bargaining agreements determine wages across the entire manufacturing sector.
collective.zh: 集体谈判协议决定了整个制造业部门的工资水平。

collective.en: The collective burden of care work falls disproportionately on rural women.
collective.zh: 照护劳动的整体负担不均衡地落在农村妇女身上。

conditional.en: Funding for the program is conditional on satisfactory progress reviews.
conditional.zh: 该项目的资金拨付以令人满意的进展评估为条件。

conditional.en: The model's predictions are conditional on the accuracy of the underlying assumptions.
conditional.zh: 该模型的预测取决于基本假设的准确性。

conditional.en: A conditional offer of admission allows applicants to decline once results are published.
conditional.zh: 附条件的录取通知允许申请者在成绩公布后拒绝入学。

deliberate.en: The omission appears deliberate rather than the result of accidental sampling error.
deliberate.zh: 这一遗漏似乎出于故意，而非随机抽样误差所致。

deliberate.en: Deliberate efforts to reduce response bias improved the quality of the survey data.
deliberate.zh: 为减少回应偏差而作出的审慎努力提升了调查数据的质量。

deliberate.en: The committee made a deliberate decision to postpone publication until replication was complete.
deliberate.zh: 委员会经深思熟虑决定推迟发表，直至重复验证完成。

ethical.en: The protocol was approved by an independent ethical review board before recruitment began.
ethical.zh: 该方案在招募开始前获得了独立伦理审查委员会的批准。

ethical.en: Researchers must disclose every ethical consideration that could affect participant consent.
ethical.zh: 研究者必须披露一切可能影响受试者知情同意的伦理考量。

ethical.en: The award recognizes outstanding ethical practice in the conduct of clinical research.
ethical.zh: 该奖项表彰了临床研究实施过程中出色的伦理实践。

finite.en: Only a finite number of responses can be collected before the survey link expires.
finite.zh: 在调查链接失效之前只能收集到有限数量的回答。

finite.en: The model assumes a finite population of households in the target district.
finite.zh: 该模型假定目标区域内的家庭总体是有限的。

finite.en: Human attention is a finite resource that must be allocated across competing tasks.
finite.zh: 人的注意力是一种必须分配给各项竞争性任务的有限资源。

formal.en: The paper provides only a formal description of the model without any empirical test.
formal.zh: 该论文仅对模型作了形式化描述，没有提供任何经验检验。

formal.en: Formal approval from the ministry is required before the survey can begin.
formal.zh: 调查启动之前须取得主管部门的正式批准。

formal.en: The distinction between formal and informal institutions shapes economic outcomes across regions.
formal.zh: 正式制度与非正式制度之间的区分影响各地区的经济结果。

hypothetical.en: The simulations explore a hypothetical scenario in which carbon prices rise sharply.
hypothetical.zh: 这些模拟探讨了碳价急剧上升的假想情形。

hypothetical.en: The example is hypothetical, but it clarifies how the estimator behaves under bias.
hypothetical.zh: 该例是假设性的，但它阐明了估计量在偏差下的表现。

hypothetical.en: Participants were asked to judge a hypothetical case rather than recall a real event.
hypothetical.zh: 受试者被要求评判一个假想案例，而非回忆真实事件。

identical.en: The two laboratories reported identical results for the same reference material.
identical.zh: 两家实验室对同一标准物质报告了完全相同的结果。

identical.en: Participants saw identical stimuli, yet their recall performance differed considerably.
identical.zh: 受试者看到的是完全相同的刺激，但回忆表现却相差甚远。

identical.en: Replication succeeded only when the analytical procedure was identical to the original design.
identical.zh: 只有在分析程序与原始设计完全一致时，重复验证才获得成功。

innovative.en: The innovative method reduces measurement error without raising the total cost.
innovative.zh: 这一创新方法在不增加总成本的情况下降低了测量误差。

innovative.en: Universities are encouraged to develop innovative teaching programs for blended delivery.
innovative.zh: 高校被鼓励开发适用于混合式教学方式的创新项目。

innovative.en: The committee praised the innovative design of the pilot study's data collection.
innovative.zh: 委员会赞赏了试点研究数据收集环节的创新设计。
